note: SPEC-18 proposal §4.6: held views kept current through the change feed. See vectors/store/README.md §11.

cases.name: no-change
cases.note: Hold two views, then refresh with no commit: nothing is read again, nothing changes, and no feed call is made.

cases.name: an-unrelated-append
cases.note: An append that no view reads: one feed page and one get, and nothing is read again.

cases.name: an-append-at-an-anchor-of-one-view
cases.note: late-g-note points at garden:1. The leaf at garden:1 is read again and changes; the leaf at bed:1 keeps its bytes.

cases.name: a-negator-of-a-member
cases.note: x-p2-name-neg negates p2-name, a member of the leaf at plant:2. It points at no anchor.

cases.name: a-negator-of-a-negator
cases.note: x-c1-height-neg-neg-neg negates c1-height-neg-neg, a member of the leaf at cutting:1 two negations deep.

cases.name: a-purge-of-a-member
cases.note: ps-name is purged. The leaf at plant:s is read again, and its bytes no longer hold ps-name. The leaf at plant:2 is a bystander: it is not read again, and its bytes stay.

cases.name: a-purge-then-a-re-add
cases.note: ps-name is purged and a refresh reads the leaf again; ps-name is then added again under a new arrival record, and the next refresh reads it again.

cases.name: a-purge-and-a-re-add-between-refreshes
cases.note: ps-name is purged and added again between two refreshes. The bytes are the same, but the member left and came back: the view is read again, and its baseline is released, so the refresh reports it with before null.

cases.name: a-touch-through-a-dynamic-anchor
cases.note: late-seed1-note points at seed:1, a grandchild the tree at plant:1 expands (plant:1, cutting:1, seed:1). The tree is read again; the leaf at plant:1 is not.

cases.name: a-view-gains-a-dynamic-anchor
cases.note: x-p2-has-c9 makes cutting:9 a child of plant:2, so the read of tree1 at plant:2 gains the anchor cutting:9. Then x-c9-height points at cutting:9 alone: the view is touched through the anchor it gained. Then x-p2-has-c9 is purged: the view is read again and loses the anchor cutting:9 and the member x-c9-height. A purge of x-c9-height then reads nothing: a holder that kept the old index entries reads the view again.

cases.name: two-views-share-an-anchor
cases.note: x-ps-height points at plant:s, an anchor of the tree at bed:1 (a child) and of the leaf at plant:s (the root). Both are read again.

cases.name: a-touch-through-a-static-anchor
cases.note: x-grant-carol points at grants, a static anchor of the lawful program. Carol's strike of c1-note now binds in the lawful view at cutting:1; the leaf at cutting:1 is not read again.

cases.name: time-moves-past-the-window-and-back
cases.note: The leaf at plant:s read at 55 has the window [36, 60): ps-note-expired stops at 60. A refresh at 59 keeps it. A refresh at 60 reads it again (the note is gone) and the next boundary moves. A refresh at 30 is below the new window and reads it again.

cases.name: a-resolved-view
cases.note: The resolve program reads cutting:1 and answers a View. late-c1-height-neg strikes c1-height there.

cases.name: a-program-with-a-selection
cases.note: before-60 keeps deltas signed at 60 or before. x-ps-height (signed at 86) touches its view at plant:s: the selection rejects it, so the bytes stay. The vectors do not pin whether such a view is read again.

cases.name: set-epoch
cases.note: The host's state behind the leaf program changes. Every view of leaf is read again; the tree is not. A second refresh reads nothing. An epoch set to the value the views were read under reads nothing.

cases.name: retention-too-short
cases.note: The store keeps one record. Two commits between refreshes drop a record the views need: the refresh resyncs, reads every held view again and releases every baseline, so every view is in changed with before null.

cases.name: another-peers-commits
cases.note: B commits deltas at garden:1. A's revision does not move: no feed call, nothing read again.

cases.name: max-views-evicts-the-least-recently-held
cases.note: The holder keeps two views. Holding leaf at plant:2 asks for garden:1 again, so bed:1 is the least recent and goes. Holding bed:1 again reads it and evicts garden:1. An append at bed:1 then reads only bed:1.

cases.name: drop
cases.note: The leaf at garden:1 is dropped. An append at garden:1 then reads nothing; holding it again reads it. Then both views are dropped: with no view held, the next hold reads no feed, though a commit came between.

cases.name: a-head-only-commit
cases.note: A commit that moves only the head: one record with no ids, no get, nothing read again.

cases.name: several-commits-in-pages-of-one
cases.note: Pages hold one record. Four commits between refreshes, one touching: one get for each page that adds.

cases.name: a-hold-passes-for-the-whole-set
cases.note: A hold of a held view passes the feed for every view. The tree at garden:1 changes during the hold of the leaf at plant:2, and the next refresh reports that change though it reads nothing again.

cases.name: a-purge-read-by-a-hold-releases-the-baseline
cases.note: The leaf at plant:s is held, then read again by a hold after x-ps-height: its baseline still carries ps-name. ps-name is purged, and a hold of the bystander leaf at plant:2 reads the purge. That pass reads the leaf at plant:s again and releases its baseline; the bystander is not read. The refresh then reports the leaf at plant:s with before null.

cases.name: a-baseline-keeps-a-member-the-view-lost
cases.note: After a refresh, the baseline of tree1 at plant:2 carries x-c9-height. A strike of the child link makes the view lose the anchor cutting:9 and the member x-c9-height, but the baseline still carries it. A purge of x-c9-height touches no current member, yet the pass that reads it releases the baseline; the refresh reports before null.

cases.name: an-evicted-view-is-read-again
cases.note: The holder keeps one view. Holding the leaf at bed:1 evicts the leaf at garden:1. late-g-note then lands at garden:1. Holding garden:1 again reads it: the new bytes, from new. A holder that kept the evicted view and served its old bytes fails here.

cases.name: an-evicted-view-held-again-answers-new
cases.note: The holder keeps one view. The host copies the leaf at garden:1 from its new answer, and a refresh follows. Holding the leaf at bed:1 evicts garden:1. late-g-note then lands at garden:1. Holding garden:1 again answers from new with the new bytes, and evicts bed:1: the host copies the new bytes, because the answer is new. The refresh reports no change, and evicted names bed:1 alone: garden:1 was evicted and held again. A host that copied only from changed would keep the old bytes of garden:1.

cases.name: an-evicted-view-not-held-again
cases.note: The holder keeps one view. late-g-note touches the leaf at garden:1; then holding the leaf at bed:1 evicts garden:1, and that pass does not read it. Holding the leaf at plant:2 evicts bed:1, and the host drops bed:1. The refresh names garden:1 in evicted, and not bed:1, which the host dropped. The next refresh names nothing.

cases.name: a-new-view-that-changes-before-the-refresh
cases.note: The leaf at garden:1 is first held after a refresh. late-g-note changes it before the next refresh, which reports it with before equal to its first answer. A view is not in changed merely because it is new.

cases.name: an-unanchored-program-is-refused
cases.note: A program whose role is aliased cannot be held: registering it is refused with the reason a read gives.
